title: Users Management
description: Manage customers, agents and staff accounts across RizqifyBD.
noPermission: Your account does not have permission to create staff accounts. Only Super Admin and Admin can do this. The server enforces this rule.
searchPlaceholder: Search users by name or email...

permissions.title: Staff creation permissions
permissions.description: Who can create which staff roles, per the existing role model.
permissions.footer: The backend also permits EMPLOYEE accounts for Super Admin and Admin actors; this interface intentionally exposes only the four roles above. AGENT is not a role — approved agents keep the Customer (USER) role with the reseller feature flag enabled.

publicSignup.note: Role can never be self-assigned — registrations always create a Customer (USER) account.

changeRole.title: Change role
changeRole.sensitive: This changes administrator-level privileges. Make sure this is intended — the action is recorded by the backend.
changeRole.notAuthorized: You are not authorized to assign any role to this user.

statusDialog.notify: {name} will be notified by the next sign-in attempt.
statusDialog.destructive: This restricts access. The backend records who performed the change and when.

descriptions.activate: The user will regain access to their account.
descriptions.deactivate: The account will be set to inactive.
descriptions.suspend: The account will be temporarily suspended.
descriptions.unsuspend: The suspension will be lifted and access restored.
descriptions.block: The user will be blocked from signing in until unblocked.
descriptions.unblock: The block will be lifted and access restored.

delete.title: Delete user?
delete.descriptionNamed: {name} ({email}) will be soft-deleted: their sessions are revoked and they can no longer sign in. The account can be restored later from the Deleted filter.
delete.note: Soft delete is reversible — data is retained, not destroyed.

restore.title: Restore user?
restore.descriptionNamed: {name} ({email}) will be reactivated with an Active status and will be able to sign in again.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.descriptionNamed: Update profile details for {name}. Only filled fields are sent.
edit.name: Full name

create.title: Create Staff Account
create.description: Grant a new member access to the RizqifyBD admin panel.
create.roleInfo: Role assignments are enforced server-side. You can grant {roles}.
create.name: Full Name

details.transactionNote: The backend does not yet expose an admin endpoint for another user's wallet transactions, so this section is intentionally omitted rather than faked.
